title: Bar Drop Mango Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Mango Lemonade by Drop brings a tropical twist to a classic soda vape. It starts with the lush, juicy sweetness of ripe mango, providing a thick and fruity base. This is immediately cut through by a sparkling lemonade finish, adding a zesty citrus lift that prevents the mango from becoming too heavy. This e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, designed to ensure the sparkling citrus notes pop against the sweet mango background for a balanced vape. Optimised for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, the nicotine salt blend offers a smooth throat hit and fast satisfaction in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
